name: Korsana Biosciences, Inc.
summary: Korsana Biosciences, Inc. develops therapeutic antibodies for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. The company has developed Therapeutic Targeting (THETA), a blood-brain barrier-penetrant shuttle platform designed to enhance central nervous system exposure of investigational therapies and enable delivery of large therapeutic molecules across the blood-brain barrier into the central nervous system. The company advances a pipeline of THETA-enabled therapeutics with an initial focus on neurodegenerative disorders.
